title: validate output
description: Printed with --json on exit 0 only: the config loaded and forgectl resolves at or above the minimum. Offline and read-only. Any other exit prints the error envelope (config_invalid, tool_missing, lower_contract_mismatch).

config_path.description: Untrusted: the main config file actually read (absolute), or null when none exists.

version.description: The version read from `forgectl --version`, three numbers only.

warnings.description: Empty when there is nothing to say. config_warning: a config file sets allow_auto_approve or a mentions.* key. forgectl_untested_version: forgectl is newer than the supported range.
